mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN i.ANSWER IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS WAITING_COUNT, COUNT(i.ANSWER) AS ANSWERED_COUNT FROM INQUIRY i
SELECT INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE, INQUIRY_TYPE_NAME FROM INQUIRY_TYPE ORDER BY INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE

SELECT i.INQUIRY_CODE, i.INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE, it.INQUIRY_TYPE_NAME, i.TITLE, i.INQUIRY_DATE, CASE WHEN i.ANSWER IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS ANSWERED FROM INQUIRY i JOIN INQUIRY_TYPE it ON it.INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE = i.INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE
AND i.INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE = #{inquiryTypeCode}
AND i.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND i.ANSWER IS NULL
AND i.ANSWER IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY i.INQUIRY_DATE DESC, i.INQUIRY_CODE DESC

SELECT i.INQUIRY_CODE, i.INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE, it.INQUIRY_TYPE_NAME, i.TITLE, i.CONTENT, i.ANSWER, i.INQUIRY_DATE, i.ANSWER_DATE, i.INQUIRY_IMG, ma.NAME AS MANAGER_NAME, CASE WHEN i.ANSWER IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS ANSWERED FROM INQUIRY i JOIN INQUIRY_TYPE it ON it.INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE = i.INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE LEFT JOIN MANAGER ma ON ma.MANAGER_CODE = i.MANAGER_CODE WHERE i.INQUIRY_CODE = #{inquiryCode} AND i.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND i.WRITER_TYPE = '작가'
